mustKnow.en: A binary heap is a complete binary tree stored in an array; max-heap: every parent >= its children, min-heap: every parent <= its children.
mustKnow.bn: Binary heap হলো array-তে রাখা একটি complete binary tree; max-heap-এ প্রতিটি parent তার children-এর >= , min-heap-এ প্রতিটি parent তার children-এর <= ।

mustKnow.en: A heap is NOT a binary search tree: there is no left<node<right ordering, only the parent-child relation, so siblings are unordered.
mustKnow.bn: Heap কোনো binary search tree নয়: left<node<right ক্রম নেই, শুধু parent-child সম্পর্ক আছে, তাই sibling-রা unordered।

mustKnow.en: 1-based array heap: for index i, left child = 2i, right child = 2i+1, parent = floor(i/2).
mustKnow.bn: 1-based array heap: index i-এর জন্য left child = 2i, right child = 2i+1, parent = floor(i/2)।

mustKnow.en: 0-based array heap: for index i, left child = 2i+1, right child = 2i+2, parent = floor((i-1)/2).
mustKnow.bn: 0-based array heap: index i-এর জন্য left child = 2i+1, right child = 2i+2, parent = floor((i-1)/2)।

mustKnow.en: Insert and extract-min/max each cost O(log n); peek (read the root) is O(1); searching an arbitrary element is O(n).
mustKnow.bn: Insert এবং extract-min/max প্রতিটির খরচ O(log n); peek (root পড়া) O(1); arbitrary element খোঁজা O(n)।

mustKnow.en: Build-heap (bottom-up heapify of n items) runs in O(n), not O(n log n); inserting n items one by one is O(n log n).
mustKnow.bn: Build-heap (n টি item-এর bottom-up heapify) চলে O(n)-এ, O(n log n)-এ নয়; একটি একটি করে n টি insert করলে O(n log n)।

mustKnow.en: Heapsort is in-place and O(n log n) in best, worst and average case, but it is NOT stable.
mustKnow.bn: Heapsort in-place এবং best, worst ও average তিন ক্ষেত্রেই O(n log n), কিন্তু এটি stable নয়।

mustKnow.en: A heap is the standard implementation of a priority queue; the max (or min) sits at the root and is served in O(1) read / O(log n) removal.
mustKnow.bn: Priority queue-এর আদর্শ implementation হলো heap; max (বা min) root-এ থাকে এবং O(1) read / O(log n) removal-এ পরিবেশিত হয়।

mustKnow.en: A heap of n nodes has height floor(log2 n); a complete binary tree of height h holds between 2^h and 2^(h+1)-1 nodes.
mustKnow.bn: n node-এর heap-এর height floor(log2 n); height h-এর complete binary tree-তে 2^h থেকে 2^(h+1)-1 টি node থাকে।

mustKnow.en: A binomial heap storing n keys consists of exactly as many binomial trees as there are 1-bits in the binary representation of n; tree B_k has 2^k nodes and height k.
mustKnow.bn: n টি key রাখা binomial heap-এ n-এর binary-তে যতগুলো 1-bit, ঠিক ততগুলো binomial tree থাকে; B_k tree-তে 2^k node ও height k।

mustKnow.en: Fibonacci heap amortized costs: insert, find-min, decrease-key and union are O(1); extract-min and delete are O(log n).
mustKnow.bn: Fibonacci heap-এর amortized খরচ: insert, find-min, decrease-key ও union হলো O(1); extract-min ও delete হলো O(log n)।

mustKnow.en: The O(1) amortized decrease-key of a Fibonacci heap is what lowers Dijkstra/Prim from O(E log V) to O(E + V log V).
mustKnow.bn: Fibonacci heap-এর O(1) amortized decrease-key-ই Dijkstra/Prim-কে O(E log V) থেকে O(E + V log V)-তে নামায়।

mustKnow.en: A B-tree of minimum degree t: every node (except the root) holds t-1 to 2t-1 keys and t to 2t children; the root holds at least 1 key.
mustKnow.bn: minimum degree t-এর B-tree: root ছাড়া প্রতিটি node-এ t-1 থেকে 2t-1 টি key ও t থেকে 2t টি child; root-এ কমপক্ষে 1 টি key।

mustKnow.en: Order and degree relate as m = 2t: a B-tree of order m has at most m children and m-1 keys, at least ceil(m/2) children per non-root node.
mustKnow.bn: Order ও degree সম্পর্ক m = 2t: order m-এর B-tree-তে সর্বোচ্চ m টি child ও m-1 টি key, প্রতিটি non-root node-এ কমপক্ষে ceil(m/2) টি child।

mustKnow.en: A B-tree with n keys and minimum degree t has height h <= log_t((n+1)/2), giving O(log_t n) worst-case search.
mustKnow.bn: n টি key ও minimum degree t-এর B-tree-এর height h <= log_t((n+1)/2), ফলে worst-case search O(log_t n)।

mustKnow.en: In a B+ tree all data records live in the leaves, internal nodes hold only routing keys, and the leaves are chained in a linked list for fast range scans; this is why database indexes use B+ trees.
mustKnow.bn: B+ tree-তে সব data record leaf-এ থাকে, internal node শুধু routing key রাখে, এবং leaf-গুলো linked list-এ chained থাকে দ্রুত range scan-এর জন্য; এজন্যই database index B+ tree ব্যবহার করে।

mustKnow.en: A 2-3 tree is a B-tree of order 3 (t=2): every internal node has 2 or 3 children (1 or 2 keys) and all leaves are at the same depth.
mustKnow.bn: 2-3 tree হলো order 3 (t=2)-এর B-tree: প্রতিটি internal node-এ 2 বা 3 টি child (1 বা 2 টি key) এবং সব leaf একই depth-এ।

mustKnow.en: B-trees stay balanced by splitting a full node on the way down during insert and by borrowing/merging during delete, so all leaves always stay at the same level.
mustKnow.bn: Insert-এ নিচে নামার পথে full node split করে এবং delete-এ borrow/merge করে B-tree balanced থাকে, তাই সব leaf সবসময় একই level-এ থাকে।

question.en: In a 1-based array heap, what are the children of index 3 and the parent of index 9?
question.bn: 1-based array heap-এ index 3-এর children এবং index 9-এর parent কী?

working.en: children of 3 = 2*3 and 2*3+1 = indices 6 and 7; parent of 9 = floor(9/2) = 4.
working.bn: 3-এর children = 2*3 ও 2*3+1 = index 6 ও 7; 9-এর parent = floor(9/2) = 4।

example.answer: children at indices 6 and 7; parent at index 4

formulas.formula: height(n)=floor(log2 n); nodes in a complete tree of height h: 2^h .. 2^(h+1)-1; leaves=ceil(n/2), internal=floor(n/2)

question.en: A binary heap has 1000 nodes. What is its height, and how many are leaves?
question.bn: একটি binary heap-এ 1000 টি node। এর height কত, এবং কতগুলো leaf?

formulas.formula: sum over levels of (nodes at that level) * (work = height below) = O(n); insert-n-times = O(n log n)

question.en: Why is building a heap of n elements O(n) but inserting them one by one O(n log n)?
question.bn: n টি element দিয়ে heap বানানো O(n) কিন্তু একটি একটি করে insert করা O(n log n) কেন?

working.en: Bottom-up heapify does O(1) work for the many leaves and O(log n) only for the single root; the series n*sum(k/2^k) converges to O(n). Repeated insert does O(log n) each for all n items.
working.bn: Bottom-up heapify বহু leaf-এর জন্য O(1) কাজ করে এবং O(log n) শুধু একটি root-এর জন্য; n*sum(k/2^k) series O(n)-এ converge করে। বারবার insert প্রতিটি n item-এ O(log n) করে।

example.answer: build-heap O(n); repeated insertion O(n log n)

formulas.formula: per non-root node: t-1 <= keys <= 2t-1, t <= children <= 2t; max keys for height h = sum_{i=0}^{h}(2t-1)(2t)^i

question.en: For a B-tree of minimum degree t=2 and height h=2 (root at level 0), what is the maximum number of keys it can hold?
question.bn: minimum degree t=2 ও height h=2 (root level 0)-এর B-tree সর্বোচ্চ কতগুলো key রাখতে পারে?

working.en: Max keys per node = 2t-1 = 3, max children = 4. Keys = 3*(1 + 4 + 16) = 3*21 = 63.
working.bn: প্রতি node-এ সর্বোচ্চ key = 2t-1 = 3, সর্বোচ্চ child = 4। Keys = 3*(1 + 4 + 16) = 3*21 = 63।

formulas.formula: h <= log_t((n+1)/2) for n keys, minimum degree t (CLRS Theorem 18.1)

question.en: A B-tree index stores 1,000,000 keys with minimum degree t=1000. Bound its height.
question.bn: একটি B-tree index minimum degree t=1000 দিয়ে 1,000,000 টি key রাখে। এর height-এর সীমা বের কর।

example.answer: height at most 1 (so <= 2 disk levels), i.e. O(log_t n)

formulas.formula: insert, find-min, decrease-key, union = O(1) amortized; extract-min, delete = O(log n) amortized

question.en: Dijkstra on a graph with V vertices and E edges does V extract-mins and up to E decrease-keys. What is the total with a Fibonacci heap?
question.bn: V vertex ও E edge-এর graph-এ Dijkstra V টি extract-min ও সর্বোচ্চ E টি decrease-key করে। Fibonacci heap দিয়ে মোট কত?

working.en: V * O(log V) + E * O(1) = O(V log V + E), versus O((V+E) log V) with a binary heap.
working.bn: V * O(log V) + E * O(1) = O(V log V + E), binary heap-এ যেখানে O((V+E) log V)।

traps.en: "A heap is a kind of binary search tree." FALSE. A heap only orders parent vs child; an in-order walk of a heap is not sorted. (This was an option in 49th BCS CSE 2025.)
traps.bn: "Heap এক ধরনের binary search tree।" ভুল। Heap শুধু parent vs child ক্রম রাখে; heap-এর in-order walk sorted নয়। (49th BCS CSE 2025-এ এটি একটি option ছিল।)

traps.en: "Build-heap is O(n log n)." WRONG for bottom-up build-heap, which is O(n). O(n log n) is the cost of inserting n keys one at a time, or of heapsort overall.
traps.bn: "Build-heap O(n log n)।" Bottom-up build-heap-এর জন্য ভুল, এটি O(n)। O(n log n) হলো একটি একটি করে n key insert, অথবা পুরো heapsort-এর খরচ।

traps.en: "Heapsort is stable." FALSE. Heapsort is in-place but not stable; merge sort is stable (but needs O(n) extra space). Don't confuse the two.
traps.bn: "Heapsort stable।" ভুল। Heapsort in-place কিন্তু stable নয়; merge sort stable (তবে O(n) অতিরিক্ত space লাগে)। দুটো গুলিয়ে ফেলো না।

traps.en: "The smallest element of a max-heap is the last array element." WRONG. The minimum of a max-heap is some leaf, but not necessarily the last one; it can be any of the ceil(n/2) leaves.
traps.bn: "Max-heap-এর ক্ষুদ্রতম element হলো শেষ array element।" ভুল। Max-heap-এর minimum কোনো leaf, কিন্তু অগত্যা শেষটি নয়; এটি ceil(n/2) টি leaf-এর যেকোনোটি হতে পারে।

traps.en: "Fibonacci heap decrease-key is O(1) worst case." WRONG. It is O(1) amortized; a single decrease-key can trigger a cascading cut costing more, and delete-min is O(n) worst case.
traps.bn: "Fibonacci heap-এর decrease-key worst case O(1)।" ভুল। এটি O(1) amortized; একটি decrease-key cascading cut ঘটিয়ে বেশি খরচ করতে পারে, এবং delete-min worst case O(n)।

traps.en: "In a B-tree every non-root node has at least t keys." WRONG. The minimum is t-1 keys (t children). The t relates to children, not keys. A 2-3 tree (t=2) therefore allows a node with just 1 key.
traps.bn: "B-tree-এ প্রতিটি non-root node-এ কমপক্ষে t টি key।" ভুল। সর্বনিম্ন t-1 টি key (t টি child)। t সম্পর্কিত child-এর সাথে, key-এর সাথে নয়। তাই 2-3 tree (t=2)-এ একটি node-এ মাত্র 1 টি key থাকতে পারে।

traps.en: "B-tree and B+ tree are the same." WRONG. In a B+ tree data lives only in the leaves and the leaves are linked for range queries; in a plain B-tree keys (and data) sit at every level.
traps.bn: "B-tree আর B+ tree একই।" ভুল। B+ tree-তে data শুধু leaf-এ থাকে এবং leaf-গুলো range query-র জন্য linked; সাধারণ B-tree-তে key (ও data) প্রতিটি level-এ থাকে।

traps.en: "Insert a new heap key wherever it fits in the tree." WRONG. A new key always goes to the next free leaf (end of the array) and then sifts up; placing it elsewhere breaks the complete-tree shape.
traps.bn: "নতুন heap key tree-তে যেখানে মানায় সেখানে বসাও।" ভুল। নতুন key সবসময় পরবর্তী খালি leaf-এ (array-এর শেষে) যায় তারপর sift up করে; অন্য জায়গায় বসালে complete-tree আকার ভেঙে যায়।

question.en: Compare B-tree and B+ tree and explain why database indexes use B+ trees.
question.bn: B-tree ও B+ tree-এর তুলনা কর এবং কেন database index B+ tree ব্যবহার করে ব্যাখ্যা কর।

en: Define B-tree (degree t, key bounds, balanced, all leaves same level)
Define B+ tree (data only in leaves, leaves linked)
Comparison table: where data sits, range scans, fanout, duplicate keys in internal nodes
Why disk/DB: high fanout -> low height -> few page reads; linked leaves -> fast range scans
Example: an index on a Bangladeshi bank's account table
bn: B-tree সংজ্ঞা (degree t, key সীমা, balanced, সব leaf একই level)
B+ tree সংজ্ঞা (data শুধু leaf-এ, leaf linked)
তুলনা table: data কোথায়, range scan, fanout, internal node-এ duplicate key
কেন disk/DB: high fanout -> কম height -> কম page read; linked leaf -> দ্রুত range scan

20.en: Add degree/order bounds and the height bound h <= log_t((n+1)/2), an insert-with-split walk-through, and a concrete DBMS index scenario with page-access counting.
20.bn: Degree/order সীমা ও height সীমা h <= log_t((n+1)/2), split সহ insert walk-through, এবং page-access গণনাসহ একটি বাস্তব DBMS index scenario যোগ কর।

question.en: What is a Fibonacci heap? Give its amortized complexities and explain why decrease-key is O(1).
question.bn: Fibonacci heap কী? এর amortized complexity দাও এবং কেন decrease-key O(1) ব্যাখ্যা কর।

en: Define: collection of heap-ordered trees, lazy consolidation
Amortized table: insert/find-min/decrease-key/union O(1), extract-min/delete O(log n)
Decrease-key: cut the node, add it to the root list, cascade marks
Why it matters: Dijkstra/Prim O(E + V log V)
Contrast with binary and binomial heaps
bn: সংজ্ঞা: heap-ordered tree-এর সংগ্রহ, lazy consolidation
Amortized table: insert/find-min/decrease-key/union O(1), extract-min/delete O(log n)
Decrease-key: node কেটে root list-এ যোগ, cascading mark
কেন গুরুত্বপূর্ণ: Dijkstra/Prim O(E + V log V)
Binary ও binomial heap-এর সাথে তুলনা

5.en: State the amortized bounds and the decrease-key idea in a few lines.
5.bn: কয়েক লাইনে amortized সীমা ও decrease-key ধারণা লেখ।

10.en: Add the amortized table, the cascading-cut mechanism, and the Dijkstra speed-up it enables.
10.bn: Amortized table, cascading-cut প্রক্রিয়া, এবং এটি যে Dijkstra গতিবৃদ্ধি আনে তা যোগ কর।

q.en: Is a heap a binary search tree?

a.en: No. A heap only guarantees parent vs child order; siblings and subtrees are not ordered, so you cannot binary-search a heap.
a.bn: না। Heap শুধু parent vs child ক্রম নিশ্চিত করে; sibling ও subtree ordered নয়, তাই heap-এ binary search করা যায় না।

q.en: Where is the minimum of a max-heap?

a.en: In one of the leaves (the lower half of the array); it is never in the upper internal nodes, but its exact leaf is not fixed.
a.bn: কোনো একটি leaf-এ (array-এর নিচের অর্ধেক); কখনো উপরের internal node-এ নয়, তবে ঠিক কোন leaf তা নির্দিষ্ট নয়।

q.en: Why is build-heap O(n) and not O(n log n)?
q.bn: Build-heap কেন O(n), O(n log n) নয়?

a.en: Most nodes are near the bottom and sift down only a little; the cost sum n*sum(k/2^k) converges to O(n).
a.bn: অধিকাংশ node নিচের দিকে এবং সামান্য sift down করে; খরচ sum n*sum(k/2^k) O(n)-এ converge করে।

q.en: Which sorting algorithm uses a heap, and is it stable?
q.bn: কোন sorting algorithm heap ব্যবহার করে, এবং এটি কি stable?

a.en: Heapsort; it is in-place and O(n log n) in all cases but it is NOT stable.
a.bn: Heapsort; এটি in-place ও সব ক্ষেত্রে O(n log n), কিন্তু stable নয়।

q.en: In a B-tree of minimum degree t, how many keys can a node hold?
q.bn: minimum degree t-এর B-tree-এ একটি node কতগুলো key রাখতে পারে?

a.en: Between t-1 and 2t-1 keys (the root may have as few as 1); children are one more than keys.
a.bn: t-1 থেকে 2t-1 টি key (root-এ ন্যূনতম 1 টি হতে পারে); child সংখ্যা key-এর চেয়ে এক বেশি।

q.en: What makes a B+ tree better for database indexes?
q.bn: B+ tree কেন database index-এর জন্য ভালো?

a.en: All records are in the leaves, which are linked, so range scans are sequential; internal nodes hold only keys, giving higher fanout and a shorter tree, hence fewer disk reads.
a.bn: সব record leaf-এ, যা linked, তাই range scan sequential; internal node শুধু key রাখে, ফলে higher fanout ও ছোট tree, তাই কম disk read।

q.en: What is the amortized cost of decrease-key in a Fibonacci heap and why is it important?
q.bn: Fibonacci heap-এ decrease-key-এর amortized খরচ কত এবং কেন গুরুত্বপূর্ণ?

a.en: O(1) amortized; it is what makes Dijkstra and Prim run in O(E + V log V).
a.bn: O(1) amortized; এটিই Dijkstra ও Prim-কে O(E + V log V)-তে চালায়।

q.en: A complete binary tree has 100 nodes. What is its height?
q.bn: একটি complete binary tree-তে 100 টি node। এর height কত?

overview.en: The binary heap is the single most-asked structure in this lesson: definition, the array index map, the four operations with costs, the O(n) build-heap, heapsort, and its use as a priority queue. Almost every PYQ here is a build/insert/extract trace or a complexity line.
overview.bn: Binary heap এই lesson-এর সবচেয়ে বেশি জিজ্ঞাসিত structure: সংজ্ঞা, array index map, খরচসহ চারটি operation, O(n) build-heap, heapsort, এবং priority queue হিসেবে ব্যবহার। এখানকার প্রায় প্রতিটি PYQ একটি build/insert/extract trace বা complexity line।

points.en: Complete binary tree + heap property; stored contiguously in an array with no pointers.
points.bn: Complete binary tree + heap property; pointer ছাড়া array-তে পরপর রাখা।

points.en: Insert = append + sift-up O(log n); extract = move last to root + sift-down O(log n); peek O(1).
points.bn: Insert = append + sift-up O(log n); extract = শেষটিকে root-এ এনে sift-down O(log n); peek O(1)।

points.en: Build-heap bottom-up is O(n); heapsort is build-heap then n-1 extract-maxes, O(n log n), in-place, not stable.
points.bn: Build-heap bottom-up O(n); heapsort হলো build-heap তারপর n-1 টি extract-max, O(n log n), in-place, stable নয়।

points.en: A heap is the go-to priority-queue implementation (schedulers, Dijkstra, Huffman coding).
points.bn: Heap হলো priority-queue-এর প্রধান implementation (scheduler, Dijkstra, Huffman coding)।

question.en: Build a max-heap from [4, 10, 3, 5, 1] by bottom-up heapify.
question.bn: [4, 10, 3, 5, 1] থেকে bottom-up heapify করে max-heap বানাও।

working.en: Last internal node is index 1 (value 10, already >= child 1). Index 0 (4): children 10,3 -> swap with 10 -> [10,4,3,5,1]; 4 at index1 vs children 5,1 -> swap with 5 -> [10,5,3,4,1].
working.bn: শেষ internal node index 1 (value 10, ইতিমধ্যে >= child 1)। Index 0 (4): children 10,3 -> 10-এর সাথে swap -> [10,4,3,5,1]; index1-এ 4 vs children 5,1 -> 5-এর সাথে swap -> [10,5,3,4,1]।

question.en: Heapsort [4, 3, 7, 1, 8, 5] — give the array after build-heap and the final sorted array.
question.bn: [4, 3, 7, 1, 8, 5] heapsort কর — build-heap-এর পরের array ও চূড়ান্ত sorted array দাও।

working.en: Build-max-heap -> [8, 4, 7, 1, 3, 5]. Then repeatedly swap root to the end and sift down until sorted.
working.bn: Build-max-heap -> [8, 4, 7, 1, 3, 5]। তারপর বারবার root-কে শেষে swap করে sift down করতে করতে sorted।
